content.title: Why ArcBest (ARCB) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of freight Delivery Company ArcBest (NASDAQ:ARCB) jumped 4.2% in the morning session after Citigroup upgraded the company's stock rating to Buy from Neutral. The revision came with a price target increase to $89 from $79. The upgrade by Citigroup analyst Ariel Rosa reflected a more positive outlook on the logistics company's current market position. This action signaled increased confidence in the stock's potential performance.
